name: Jose Jerez
headline: Simplifying operations through automation and design
summary: IT Operations professional specializing in workflow automation, identity management, SaaS administration, and enterprise systems. Experienced supporting a workforce of 3,500–5,000 employees while designing automations, integrations, and operational workflows that improve efficiency, visibility, and service delivery.
interests: Outside of technology, I enjoy baseball, football, hiking, camping, cooking, music, and finding great places to explore with my family.

projects.title: Asset Recovery Automation Platform
projects.description: Designed and implemented an automated asset recovery workflow that generates return labels, tracks equipment status, automates follow-up communications, and improves asset visibility.
projects.outcome: Less manual follow-up. Clearer equipment status.

projects.title: Verification Management Workflow
projects.description: Built a verification workflow with automated intake, applicant tracking, flagged record detection, duplicate prevention, notifications, and dashboard reporting.
projects.outcome: Structured intake and better visibility into verification work.

projects.title: SLA Response Automation
projects.description: Developed automated reminder and escalation workflows that reduced average first-response times from approximately 18–19 minutes to 5–8 minutes.
projects.outcome: 5–8 minute first response in this workflow, down from 18–19 minutes.

projects.title: Distribution List Request Portal
projects.description: Created a structured request workflow replacing manual Slack requests and improving fulfillment efficiency.
projects.outcome: A repeatable request process with clearer fulfillment.

experienceAreas.title: IT operations & support
experienceAreas.description: Supporting enterprise teams, resolving tickets, and improving response and resolution times across a workforce of 3,500–5,000 employees.

experienceAreas.title: Identity & access management
experienceAreas.description: Experience with Okta, SSO, SAML, MFA, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365 across enterprise environments.

experienceAreas.title: Workflow automation & integrations
experienceAreas.description: Connecting business processes through automated intake, notifications, reporting, asset workflows, and REST APIs.
